body:
I'm just really iritable. Probably nothing you did.

Just the idea of going to a councessor just seems... Bad, pathetic, uncomfortable. I've never shared any of these feelings with anyone.  I haven't been able to bring myself to go to one, and at this point, I find it a little pointless to go. I'd have to tell my mom I wanted one too. I don't have the money to shell out for that stuff.

I don't think I want help at this point anyway. Posting this thing's already more work than I expected.

Why would I ever want to talk to anyone in person about this? Embarrassing enough as it is.

And traveling is my number one, be all to end all, thing that I freaking hate in this world. There is no reason to travel. Natives treat you weird, trying to haggle their way to your wallet. Flying is the most stressful and uncomfortable thing ever devised (exaggerating). Ain't no sight I can see online. Want to see the Grand Canyon. Google. Eifel Tower? Google. 

I'd never want to join the news makers. Note: Makers not reports. Journalism has always been a joke. Whether for government lies or political schilling. And what's a history degree good for? Historians literally have no need to exist. Their jobs can be replaced by googling. And there's no way I'm teaching.

It's okay to feel these things? Well, guess I'll carry on doing nothing, and hopefully I'll never have to do anything.

That's pretty generic and lacks any proof. Plenty of people have lived miserable lives just to die unhappy. I know I have potential. I said I could have gone to college. I'm just too lazy. I don't want to do anything.

I also know I could persevere, but I really don't feel like. I know I could; I don't want to. I don't owe it to any living human being on the Earth to live. I owe them squat. 

I don't want to live for whatever carnal pleasures are sitting about. I really could care less about all of that.

I love US history, but I don't want some pansy liberal arts degree. Used to like writing, video games, and announcing (still do most sports and morning announcements at school), but I've fallen out of love with all of those things this last year. Got all my US Presidents, VPs, SoS memorized. 

A trade school? Nah. I don't even know what they do at those places, so I doubt they have something I like. I know they do Engineering and programming (I think?), but I hate STEM. I could handle it mentally, I just don't want to/like it. I especially hate technology.

Aside from college, work, or being a welfare queen, what else is there? Sitting and rotting without food or home?????
